entities.summary: Richard Barry Parker was an English architect and urban planner associated with the Arts and Crafts Movement. He was primarily known for his architectural partnership with Raymond Unwin. Richard Barry Parker was a architects & engineers from Chesterfield (1867-11-18, Chesterfield–1947-02-21). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
